purpose: Portable font fixtures for SDF text and cooked Player regressions
setup: Copy the unmodified font and its license into an isolated test Assets/Fonts directory; write a .meta sidecar using assetGuid. Never copy system fonts. These GUIDs belong only to regression fixtures.
checks: Empty fontPath resolves deployed Inter and bundled Korean fallback without a source checkout
Explicit project GUID resolves through the CEMF source table after packaging
Font paths and prefab fontPath overrides become GUIDs in cooked scene documents
Same filenames in different project directories preserve distinct identities
Missing sidecars, unknown/wrong-kind GUIDs, and external absolute font paths fail cooking
Both complete font licenses remain in Editor, Player, and game package outputs
